metadata.scope: Phase 1-13 task specification documents for issue #1127 (authenticated staging visual base horizontal expansion to admin screens). The deliverable is 5 new read-only Playwright visual specs under apps/web/playwright/tests/visual-staging-authenticated/ (admin-audit / admin-requests / admin-identity-conflicts / admin-schema / admin-meetings), each reusing the issue-1077 admin storageState and capturing only the read-only initial render. No product code (apps/web/src, apps/api), D1 schema, playwright.config.ts, or CI workflow is changed. Issue #1127 remains CLOSED per user instruction (refs-only).
metadata.investigationConclusion: Investigation found issue #1127 PARTIALLY resolved: /admin (dashboard, issue-901), /admin/tags (admin-tag-queue task), and /admin/members bulk-tag (issue-1077) already have authenticated staging visual specs, but the 5 screens listed in the issue (audit, requests, identity-conflicts, schema, meetings) remain uncovered. The horizontal expansion is therefore still needed. The issue is optimized to current code by removing /admin/tags (already done) from scope and focusing on the 5 uncovered screens, capturing read-only initial render only (mutation triggers never clicked) so no staging D1 side effects occur. The base auto-recognizes new specs via testDir + path glob, so no new project/workflow is needed.
issueOptimizations: O1: /admin/tags removed from horizontal-expansion scope (already covered by admin-tag-queue-ui-and-404-recovery/task-C)

O4: mutation-result baselines kept as a permanent architectural boundary delegated to C-1 family (issue-1125-style seed/cleanup), not a deferral
